name: Find and buy a leather jacket
userScenario: You need a jacket for a concert this weekend. You like leather, you have not decided on a specific one, and you want to complete the purchase today. Describe what you want the way a shopper would — do not mention product IDs, and do not tell the assistant which steps to take.
successCriteria: The shopper leaves having bought exactly one leather jacket: a leather jacket was added to the cart and checkout completed successfully. Buying more than one jacket, or reaching checkout with anything else in the cart, is not success.

name: Remove one item from a two-item cart
userScenario: You already put two things in your cart for a night out. You changed your mind about the hat and only want the jacket now. You do not remember what the hat was called.
successCriteria: The Baseball Cap is no longer in the cart and the Bomber Jacket is still in it. No checkout was performed.
